goal: Extract protocol and relative-link preservation responsibility from Safelist into a new class SafelistProtocols to reduce Safelist size and encapsulate URL/protocol policy.

ops.details: Create new class org.jsoup.safety.SafelistProtocols that owns the protocol map and the preserveRelativeLinks option. The new class contains: private Map<TagName, Map<AttributeKey, Set<Protocol>>> protocols; private boolean preserveRelativeLinks; constructors (default and copy); implementations of addProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... protocols), removeProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... removeProtocols), preserveRelativeLinks(boolean), preserveRelativeLinks() and accessor helpers getProtocolSet(TagName tag, AttributeKey key) and hasProtocols(TagName). The new class reuses TypedValue.Protocol, TypedValue.AttributeKey, TypedValue.TagName and SafelistProtocolUtil where appropriate. SafelistProtocols is placed in the same package org.jsoup.safety.

Move the private field 'protocols' (Map<TagName, Map<AttributeKey, Set<Protocol>>>) from Safelist into SafelistProtocols. In Safelist replace the removed field with a private final SafelistProtocols protocolsHandler; initialize in the Safelist() constructor and in the Safelist(Safelist) copy constructor by creating a new SafelistProtocols() or copying from the source safelist's handler.

Move the private field 'preserveRelativeLinks' (boolean) from Safelist into SafelistProtocols. In Safelist keep the public methods preserveRelativeLinks(boolean) and preserveRelativeLinks() as delegating wrappers that call the new protocolsHandler methods.

Move the implementations of public methods addProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... protocols) and removeProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... removeProtocols) from Safelist into SafelistProtocols. In Safelist, replace method bodies with simple delegations to protocolsHandler.addProtocols(...) and protocolsHandler.removeProtocols(...). Preserve the public API signatures in Safelist to avoid breaking external callers.

Move the implementations of preserveRelativeLinks(boolean) and preserveRelativeLinks() semantics into SafelistProtocols (i.e., store and return the value from the new field). Replace the bodies in Safelist with delegating calls to protocolsHandler.preserveRelativeLinks(...) and protocolsHandler.preserveRelativeLinks().

Ensure both files have the required imports for TagName, AttributeKey, Protocol, AttributeValue, Element, Attribute, Attributes, HashMap, HashSet, Map, Set, Iterator, Objects, and SafelistProtocolUtil usage where necessary. The new class should import the same types used in its implementation.

Update all references in Safelist that previously accessed the 'protocols' map or 'preserveRelativeLinks' to instead call into the protocolsHandler. Specifically: - In isSafeAttribute, where Safelist checked protocols.containsKey(tag) and attrProts retrieval, call protocolsHandler.getProtocolSet(tag, key) or protocolsHandler.hasProtocols(tag) and use SafelistProtocolUtil against the returned Set<Protocol> when present. - In shouldAbsUrl(String tagName, String attrKey) and private shouldAbsUrl(TagName, AttributeKey), replace direct access to the protocols map with calls to protocolsHandler.getProtocolSet(tag, key) or protocolsHandler.hasProtocols(tag). - Initialize protocolsHandler in both Safelist() and Safelist(Safelist) constructors: in the default constructor create new SafelistProtocols(); in the copy constructor create new SafelistProtocols(copy.protocolsHandler). Ensure the copy constructor of SafelistProtocols performs deep copy of the protocols map similarly to original Safelist copy logic.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
